## What these figures mean

As for vols. 1–3 and 6: see `ocr/03/articles-report.md` for how articles are located, and
`ocr/06/articles-report.md` for `folded`. Every row is `status: "ocr"`. Nothing is proofread.

## Vol. 25 specifics

- Located **95.3%** (20.0% by fuzzy match), label + body 87.4%, compound analysis 71.6%. At 300 dpi
  the same step gave 93.3% and 86.5%.
- No typed witness covers this book.
- The index sometimes gives one printed entry two rows: on p. 159 the entry
  သ္နေဟယတိ၊ သ္နေဟေတိ (ကာ၊ကြိ) is indexed twice as "သ္နေဟယတိ= သ္နေဟေတိ"; one row is placed, the
  other stays unlocated.

## Spot check

Two pages, on the image (25 Sep 2026):

- **p. 400** (a middle page): 9 of 9 at the right entry; 8 labels right, 1 not read
  (ဟီနာဒိဘေဒဘိန္နတာဒဿန, (န), read as ၅).
- **p. 159** (the worst page, the သ္နေ headwords): 10 of 11 index rows at the right entry by fuzzy
  match, 1 unlocated (the second row of the doubled entry above), none wrong; 7 labels right,
  2 not read ((ကာ၊ ကြို) on the doubled entry, (န) on သ္နေဟဝိဂမန).

20 index rows checked: 19 right, 1 unlocated, none wrong.
